2014_spells.mage-armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.
2014_spells.mage-armor.effectSummary: Change a target: touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends
2014_spells.mage-armor.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier; The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.
